name: AvatarGroup
intent: Overlapping row of kit Avatars with a +N count for the rest.
usage: Use for several people on a row, card or table cell. Only kit Avatars go in the group. People past max collapse into a +N count, not another face. One person is a plain Avatar. See contracts/avatargroup.json for the full contract.

label.note: Names the group for screen readers, like Assignees.

size.note: Applied to every Avatar and the count. xs is 24 px, the table row size.

shape.note: Applied to every Avatar and the count.

max.note: How many Avatars show before +N. No count when items.length <= max.

items.note: Two or more people. Same fields as Avatar.

useWhen: Several people on a row, card or table cell, like assignees or viewers.
doNot: Do not invent a local avatar stack.
Do not put anything but people in the group.
Do not use for one person. Use Avatar.
Do not put a status dot on a face.
Do not make the group clickable.
a11y: Each Avatar keeps its own name.
The +N count reads as N more.
snippet: <AvatarGroup label="Assignees" items={[{ name: "Boris Jovanovic" }, { name: "Ada Jones" }, { name: "Mira" }, { name: "Leo" }]} />

examples.title: Tight stack
examples.usage: Four people with max 4. When everyone fits, there is no count.

examples.title: Overflow +N
examples.usage: Six people with max 3. The rest is a count (+3), not an Avatar.

examples.title: All photos
examples.usage: Every face can be a photo. The ring in the page color keeps each face readable.

examples.title: Square
examples.usage: Square follows the Avatar shape. Use it where the list already uses square Avatars.
